canon.name: Windows XD
canon.frame: the inside of Windows XD, a made up 2003 home computer in the style of Windows XP, where every program is a living place the camera dives into and moves through, glossy and saturated, filling the whole wide 16:9 frame
canon.still: Soft white clouds drift over the green hill, a little buddy figure on the Messenger icon waves as a friend signs on with a knock, the icons shine, and in the last second the desktop holds steady
canon.approach: In the first half second, {thing} lights up glossy blue and the camera rushes toward it
canon.arrive: the camera dives straight through the glass into {thing}, already roaring with life
canon.leave: {thing} shatters into flying pixels and falls away behind the camera
canon.settle: In the last second, the camera comes to rest on a clear steady view of where it now is, every thing in its own place
canon.ambient: A computer fan hums softly under the desk while faint suburban birdsong drifts in from outside
canon.selectSound: A soft plastic tap and a bright startup chime
canon.lettering: crisp small Tahoma style sans in Title Case, white on blue and black on gray

around.phrase: All around the camera, filling the whole frame

far.phrase: Towering in the distance straight ahead

center.phrase: In the middle of the view

left.phrase: On the left side of the view

right.phrase: On the right side of the view

air.phrase: Floating high in the air above the middle of the view

column.1.phrase: At the top of a single column of five icons hugging the far left edge

column.3.phrase: In the middle of the icon column

right.bottom.phrase: In the far bottom right corner, just above the taskbar

flood.phrase: Bursting across the whole frame in front of everything

ladder.mood: a perfect cozy 2003 afternoon, every program a place to dive into
peak nostalgia, then something sketchy opens and popups start to breed
ladder.ambient: Sunlight glints across glossy chrome and bright gradients
ladder.sound: A dial up modem warbles and screeches in another room

ladder.mood: infected: popups multiply and the whole world glitches and tears
ladder.ambient: Glitch stripes and scanlines rip across the whole picture
ladder.sound: An error ding plays again and again, faster each time

ladder.mood: the virus is a creature eating the computer alive
ladder.ambient: Chunks of the world crumble into falling pixels
ladder.sound: A squeaky giggle echoes through everything

ladder.mood: all out war: every program is a literal weapon against the monster
ladder.ambient: Sparks and loose pixels fly as the whole world trembles
ladder.sound: A huge heroic orchestra swells under cartoon crashes

ladder.mood: the finale and total victory, brighter than ever
ladder.ambient: Fireworks and bouncing cards fill a brilliant blue sky
ladder.sound: A triumphant fanfare plays with the startup chime

filler: Everything is glossy 2003 computer graphics with smooth bright gradients
Rounded chrome, royal blue title bars and grass green fill the picture
Edges are crisp and colors are rich and saturated
All lettering is the crisp small Tahoma style sans of 2003, in Title Case
Lettering is small and high contrast, with clear space around every word
Each thing that can be chosen sits apart with open space around it
Everything is huge around the camera, like a tiny visitor inside a computer
The picture is sharp from edge to edge with a steady exposure
The whole world is in constant motion until the clip comes to rest
Light glints off glossy plastic, chrome and glass
The scene fills the wide frame from the far left edge to the far right edge
The camera ends every move steady, holding a clear view of the scene
